answer: The nebula is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the karst. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the dawn of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
